name: Alchemy Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Craft (alchemy) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Poison Lore (Ex)

You gain a deep understanding and appreciation for poisons.

You are trained in the use of poison and cannot accidentally poison yourself when applying poison to a weapon. If you spend 1 minute physically examining a poison, you can attempt a Knowledge (nature) check to identify any natural poison or a Knowledge (arcana) check to identify any magical poison (DC = the poison’s saving throw DC).

Lastly, once a poison is identified, you can spend 1 minute and attempt a Craft (alchemy) check (DC = the poison’s saving throw DC) to neutralize 1 dose of the poison. Success renders the dose harmless.

You have no chance of accidentally poisoning yourself when examining or attempting to neutralize a poison.

Associated Technique
Bullseye Technique (Ex)

While you employ this technique, you can choose to waive any splash damage that an alchemical weapon would normally do in order to concentrate the effects of that weapon’s damage upon the target you have studied with this ability.

The weapon does no damage to anyone if you miss including your target. If you hit your target, that target takes regular damage plus an additional amount of damage equal to 1/2 your scholar level (minimum 1).

Advanced Study Abilities
Discovery

Prerequisite(s): Poison Studies study ability, scholar level 2nd.

Select an alchemist discovery for which you meet all prerequisites, using your ranks in Craft (alchemy) as your effective alchemist level. You cannot select discoveries that modify class features you don’t have (such as bombs or extracts).

Special: You may select this study ability a second time once you reach scholar level 6th, and a third time once you reach scholar level 10th.

Poison Resistance (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Poison Studies study ability, scholar level 2nd.

After repeated exposure to toxins of all varieties, you gain a high degree of resistance to poison. You can roll your Craft (alchemy) skill check in place of a saving throw against any poison. You cannot take 10 on this check. Once you attain 15 ranks in Craft (alchemy), you are immune to all poisons.
